summary: This informational document registers the application/pkcs8-encrypted media type for the PKCS #8 EncryptedPrivateKeyInfo type. A file or message of this type carries a single encrypted private key, BER-encoded. Registration helps software identify such data consistently.

eli5.summary: A locked box needs a label saying 'locked key inside.' This registers the official label for a file holding one encrypted secret key.
